title: docs(adr): ADR-0128 §4 gets a dated note — the keyed-digest break (#21263, PR #21292) did not carry D1, and why
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 1 (`session_01UtnxvdiN376GF3sgXwAw4d`, seat post #6017) as an execution parameter of the maintainer's ruling **A** on #21263 (`5945612493`, batch #267 item 1, 「其他同意」). ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Lane and priority are triage's. The edit is a governed surface (`docs/adr/**`, Tier H), so it is not this seat's to author.

## What the ruling asks

The ruling reads: "ADR-0128 dated note: one sentence under §4 recording that the keyed-digest break (#21263, PR #21292) did not carry D1, and why: zero out-of-repo implementers measured in the organisation (5945420994). It is a Tier H PR, held for the maintainer's own approval."

## Why the note is owed

ADR-0128 §4 ("The trigger that would fund it") says: "`ICryptoProvider` is opened for another breaking change. … A queued breaking change to this interface should pull D1 in with it." PR #21292 opens `ICryptoProvider` for a breaking change (a required `keyedDigest` member) and lands without D1, by the maintainer's ruling. An accepted ADR whose recorded preference is departed from carries a dated note saying so. Otherwise a later reader takes the departure for an oversight.

## Shape

- One dated sentence under §4's third trigger. It names #21263 / PR #21292 and the ruling `5945612493`. It also gives the reason: the director's census `5945420994` measured zero out-of-repo `ICryptoProvider` implementations across the organisation's repositories, so bundling would have saved a second break for no measured population.
- It points at the D1 scheduling card, #21326.
- ⛔ No change to D1–D4 or to the ADR's status.
- A Tier H PR is held for the maintainer's approval, and its body carries the `## 维护者速读(草稿)` draft.

Dedupe words: ADR-0128 dated note keyed digest D1 not carried · ICryptoProvider breaking change trigger §4
